QuestInfo.name: Black Wings' New Weapon
QuestInfo.0: Talk to #p2151001#, who seems to have recovered.
QuestInfo.1:
The Black Wings's new weapon has already been completed. #p2151001# realized how dangerous it was and tried to destroy it, but ended up getting thrown in jail. You can't just sit there and do nothing! Destroy the #rBlack Wings's new weapon#k and rescue #p2151001#!

#o9001035##r #a230491##k

#b* If you leave the map, you can enter again through the hidden laboratory entrance in #r#m310060220##b.
QuestInfo.2: After completely destroying the Black Wings' new weapon, you returned with #p2151001# using the Underground Base #t4032740#. It was no easy task, but your execution was perfect.

0.0: Ah, much better. I'm ready to explain now. Initially, my goal was just to interrupt the development of the weapon, but when I got there, the weapon was already done. It was a #r#o9001035##k that looked extremely dangerous.
0.1: It hadn't been fully tested, but I wanted to stop it from being delivered, so I tried to destroy it...alone. And, well, I failed. The poison gas was potent. And that's how I ended up caged, as you saw.
0.2: We can get out of here easily with the #t4032740# you have, but we can't in good conscience leave. The poison gas in that device could wipe out all of Edelstein in an instant! We HAVE to destroy that weapon before we leave.

yes.0: Honestly, I don't know if you'll be able to pull it off. I'm not sure if a human can endure the powerful poison gas, but you and I are the only ones here, so I guess I have to trust you. Besides, I think you've got what it takes. I hope.
yes.1: The new weapon is on the other side of #bthat door#k. They might want to test the weapon on us... You must destroy it before the weapon kills us!

no.0: Poison is dangerous because it can target a large population at once. The Black Wings can point that thing toward Edelstein at their whim. Please, think it over!

mob.0: Have you not destroyed the #r#o9001035##k yet? It's extremely powerful, so thoroughly prepare yourself. Grrr, I should have brought more antidotes and potions!
